name: mppi-soft-landing
description: Escape + soft landing on the rigid twin, 6 presets x 10 seeds (1..10: mulberry32 maps seed 0 to 1, so seeds 0 and 1 draw the same initial condition). pd vs MPPI with the baseline settings vs MPPI with the soft-body settings flown closed loop on the soft body (public/sims/flight-mppi-*.sim): slip and ground yaw terms, 2 s / 8-probe kerb lookahead with a footprint margin, stiff touchdown tilt / rate weights, bottom residual faded out below 3 m and a softer base pd (td_speed 0.5). Runs identically in JS (node tools/flight/bench.mjs, ~2.5 s / episode) and Python (python -m coldgas.bench, ~18 s / episode): MPPI is bit-identical across the twins.
